status: advisory research only; parent decides final labels
scope: Assigned common fixed oils plus separately requested exact hybrid/corn declarations; not market completeness
rules: All proposed weights are rough priors, not validated hair heaviness.
Confidence describes confidence in weight estimate, not identity. All currently low.
Skin feel, supplier hair descriptors, viscosity, spreading and measured hair heaviness are separate evidence kinds.
No default medium; no density, fatty-acid, penetration or viscosity threshold conversion.
aliases are reviewed label spelling forms only; identity_exclusions prohibit automatic merging.
Do not transfer a supplier-grade result to modified oils, extracts or essential oils.
excluded_from_assignment: Cannabis Sativa Seed Oil: already covered by parent

A01.title: Gustav Heess: Corn oil refined Ph. Eur. 12, Sp314031g
A01.short_paraphrase: One refined corn grade lists both Zea Mays Oil and Zea Mays Germ Oil.
A01.limitations: Same-grade alternate declarations do not authorize a universal alias. No sensory assessment.

A02.title: EU cosmetic ingredient inventory, consolidated 2006
A02.locator: ZEA MAYS GERM OIL and ZEA MAYS OIL entries
A02.short_paraphrase: Germ Oil is germ-derived fixed oil; Oil is defined as refined fixed oil from wet milling corn.
A02.limitations: Historical identity evidence only; not a current regulatory determination or weight evidence.

A03.title: O&3: Maize Seed Oil, Refined, K0275
A03.short_paraphrase: Exact Germ Oil declaration; light and non-greasy skin description.
A03.limitations: Sensory phrase is repeated verbatim across many oils; weak evidence, no hair weight assessment.

A04.title: O&3: Soyabean Oil, Refined Organic, K1325
A04.short_paraphrase: Glycine Soja Oil; supplier specifically describes a lightweight contribution to hair formulations.
A04.limitations: Commercial claim without hair panel, dose or comparator; refined organic grade.

A05.title: Ellemental: Sesame oil Organic, D-1653
A05.short_paraphrase: Cold-pressed unrefined Sesamum Indicum Seed Oil has medium texture; viscosity is separately described as medium.
A05.limitations: Skin/material descriptor, not measured hair heaviness. Do not use viscosity alone.

A06.title: Ellemental: Rice bran oil, D-1678
A06.locator: Characteristics; Ingredients; Hair care / Practical recommendations
A06.short_paraphrase: Oryza Sativa Bran Oil has light texture; supplier describes a few leave-in drops without weighing hair down.
A06.limitations: Lightly refined/dewaxed grade; commercial hair claim without measured heaviness panel.

A07.title: Oat Cosmetics: Oat Lipid e
A07.locator: Skin/Haircare Claims; Ingredient Nomenclature; oil extraction paragraph
A07.short_paraphrase: Avena Sativa Kernel Oil grade has non-greasy skin feel and low viscosity; hair claims concern detangling and silkiness.
A07.limitations: Ethanol-extracted specialty grade; rich refers also to lipids and colour. No measured hair heaviness.

A08.title: O&3: Rapeseed Oil (Canola Oil), Cold Pressed
A08.short_paraphrase: Brassica Campestris Seed Oil grade is described as light and non-greasy.
A08.limitations: Commercial skin-oriented descriptor; cannot alias all rapeseed species or modified canola derivatives.

A09.title: Ota Oil: Domestic refined rapeseed oil
A09.short_paraphrase: Supplier specifies Brassica Napus Seed Oil, expressed then refined.
A09.limitations: Identity only; pale colour and fatty-acid measurements are not weight evidence.

A10.title: Aarnav Global: Brassica Napus Seed Oil bulk
A10.locator: Brassica Napus Seed Oil product section
A10.short_paraphrase: Supplier calls exact Brassica Napus Seed Oil a lightweight cosmetic carrier.
A10.limitations: Low-quality commercial copy with inconsistent surrounding food/pharma fields; no panel or technical sensory method.
A10.access: primary supplier product section retrieved in search, 2026-10-02

A11.title: AAK Personal Care Product Catalogue

A11.limitations: Portfolio contains processed oils and concentrates. Identity relationship is supplier-specific, not universal sensory equivalence.
A11.access: primary supplier brochure retrieved in search, 2026-10-02

A12.title: O&3: Linseed Oil, Refined, K0738
A12.short_paraphrase: Linum Usitatissimum Seed Oil grade has explicit lightweight hair moisturization wording.
A12.limitations: Unquantified supplier claim for refined oil; no proof for all cold-pressed grades.

A13.title: NDA: Evening Primrose Carrier Oil, Cosmetic Grade Refined
A13.locator: More About / Color-Consistency and Absorption; suggested usage
A13.short_paraphrase: Refined seed oil leaves oily skin residue; supplier describes medium viscosity and low-percentage hair use without heaviness.
A13.limitations: Diluted hair-use claim cannot establish neat oil weight; no panel. Medium viscosity is not a medium-weight rule.

A14.title: O&3: Evening Primrose Oil, Cold Pressed Organic, K0182
A14.short_paraphrase: Oenothera Biennis Oil; non-greasy/light skin wording.
A14.limitations: Repeated functionality template; conflicts with NDA residual-feel description; different processing.

A15.title: NDA: Borage Carrier Oil RBDW
A15.short_paraphrase: Refined borage seed oil leaves oily skin feel.
A15.limitations: No calibrated richness or hair-weight assessment; supplier FAQ also mislabels linoleic acid as omega-3, reducing copy reliability.

A16.title: Gya Labs: Organic Borage Oil
A16.short_paraphrase: Cold-pressed borage oil is described as lightweight with little heaviness on skin.
A16.limitations: Brand commercial description; contrasts with refined NDA oil; no controlled comparison.

A17.title: Naturochim: NAT Organic Deodorized Camelina Oil
A17.short_paraphrase: Exact Camelina Sativa Seed Oil is described as a light oil with dry skin feel.
A17.limitations: Supplier descriptor for deodorized cold-pressed grade; no hair-weight panel.

A18.title: Dauphine Organics: Chia Seed Oil V ORG
A18.short_paraphrase: Exact Salvia Hispanica Seed Oil is described as light, silky and non-greasy.
A18.limitations: Supplier commercial description for virgin grade; no hair weight measurement.

A19.title: O&3: Blackcurrant Seed Oil, Cold Pressed, K0509
A19.short_paraphrase: Exact Ribes Nigrum Seed Oil has light/non-greasy skin wording.
A19.limitations: Repeated functionality template is weak evidence; specific opening copy gives only velvety/nourishing feel.

A20.title: NDA: Black Currant Seed Carrier Oil RBDW
A20.locator: More About / Aromatic Description and Absorption
A20.short_paraphrase: Heavy/oily describes odour; absorption and consistency are generic carrier-oil descriptions.
A20.limitations: Does not establish rich texture. Refined grade and no explicit weight descriptor.

A21.title: Gustav Heess: Cosmetic Product List
A21.locator: p5 ordinary and high-oleic sunflower rows; p4 rapeseed; p2 corn/chia
A21.short_paraphrase: Both sunflower rows are fairly light; rapeseed has medium spreading; corn has no sensory weight claim; chia spreads slowly.
A21.limitations: Supplier range descriptions, no hair testing. Layout extracted with PyMuPDF sort=True to resolve table rows.
A21.access: public PDF opened with web and independently downloaded/read, 2026-10-02

A22.title: Nordmann / AAK: Akosun
A22.short_paraphrase: Helianthus Annuus Hybrid Oil is a refined high-oleic selected-sunflower grade.
A22.limitations: Identity and stability evidence, no direct weight descriptor.

A23.title: Oleon: LUCEE Oil Macadamia RBD 6792
A23.short_paraphrase: Exact Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil has an explicit lightweight skin descriptor.
A23.limitations: Refined, bleached, deodorized grade; no hair weight measurement or botanical taxonomy resolution.

A24.title: Interchimie: Refined macadamia nut oil
A24.locator: INCI and Description du produit chimique
A24.short_paraphrase: Macadamia integrifolia tetraphylla seed oil is pressed/refined and low-viscosity.
A24.limitations: No sensory weight claim. Slashless declaration needs comparison with slash-bearing supplier identity; not a pure species alias.

A25.title: MakingCosmetics: Macadamia Nut Oil SDS
A25.short_paraphrase: SDS names Macadamia integrifolia tetraphylla seed oil.
A25.limitations: Identity only; no true sensory/heaviness evidence.

A26.title: Gustav Heess: Organic macadamia nut oil
A26.short_paraphrase: Lists Macadamia Integrifolia / Tetraphylla Seed Oil.

A27.title: MakingCosmetics: Rice Bran Oil specification, 2025-08-04
A27.short_paraphrase: Uses Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Oil for refined, bleached, deodorized, winterized rice-bran oil.
A27.limitations: Identity corroboration only; reasonable emollience does not quantify weight.

A28.title: Raasa Oils: Cottonseed Oil
A28.locator: Product Specifications; FAQ / What is Cottonseed Oil used for?
A28.short_paraphrase: Exact Gossypium Hirsutum Seed Oil is described as a light refined carrier for skin and hair.
A28.limitations: Supplier commercial copy; cold-pressed/refined processing wording is broad; no measured hair heaviness. Does not justify aliasing Herbaceum.

A29.title: AAK: LIPEX 120
A29.short_paraphrase: Exact Canola Oil declaration for refined canola with added antioxidants.
A29.limitations: Identity confirmation only. Low recommended dosage and stability are not light-weight evidence.
